"""Live one-episode controller for the MolmoSpaces stopwatch task."""
from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation

r = Robot()
DT = 0.264

def pose_quat_for_finger_axis(axis_xy):
    # TCP local z points down. Local y is the 2F-85 opening/closing axis.
    y = np.array([axis_xy[0], axis_xy[1], 0.0], dtype=float)
    y /= np.linalg.norm(y)
    z = np.array([0.0, 0.0, -1.0])
    x = np.cross(y, z)
    qxyzw = Rotation.from_matrix(np.column_stack((x, y, z))).as_quat()
    return np.array([qxyzw[3], qxyzw[0], qxyzw[1], qxyzw[2]])

def ik(xyz, quat, seed):
    ans = r.ik({"gripper": [*map(float, xyz), *map(float, quat)]}, seed=seed)
    if not ans.get("ok"):
        raise RuntimeError(f"IK failed at {xyz}: {ans}")
    return np.asarray(ans["q"], dtype=float)

def move_q(q, grip, seconds=2.64, cameras=None):
    n = max(2, int(round(seconds / DT)))
    rows = np.repeat(np.r_[q, grip][None, :], n, axis=0)
    return r.submit("joint_position", rows, dt=DT, video="frames", cameras=cameras)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    o = r.get_obs()
    start = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"][:7], dtype=float)
    grip_axis = [-0.98, -0.21]
    quat = pose_quat_for_finger_axis(grip_axis)
    target_xy = [10.998, 9.213]
    q_pre = ik([*target_xy, 1.27], quat, start)
    print("start", start, "pregrasp", q_pre, "quat", quat, "status", r.status())
    res = move_q(q_pre, 0, seconds=2.64)
    print("pregrasp finished", r.status(), "tcp", res.meta["proprio"]["now"][-7:])

"""Live one-episode controller for the MolmoSpaces stopwatch task."""
from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation

r = Robot()
DT = 0.264

def pose_quat_for_finger_axis(axis_xy):
    # TCP local z points down. Local y is the 2F-85 opening/closing axis.
    y = np.array([axis_xy[0], axis_xy[1], 0.0], dtype=float)
    y /= np.linalg.norm(y)
    z = np.array([0.0, 0.0, -1.0])
    x = np.cross(y, z)
    qxyzw = Rotation.from_matrix(np.column_stack((x, y, z))).as_quat()
    return np.array([qxyzw[3], qxyzw[0], qxyzw[1], qxyzw[2]])

def ik(xyz, quat, seed):
    ans = r.ik({"gripper": [*map(float, xyz), *map(float, quat)]}, seed=seed)
    if not ans.get("ok"):
        raise RuntimeError(f"IK failed at {xyz}: {ans}")
    return np.asarray(ans["q"], dtype=float)

def move_q(q, grip, seconds=2.64, cameras=None):
    n = max(2, int(round(seconds / DT)))
    now = np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=[]).meta["proprio"]["now"][:7], dtype=float)
    arm_rows = np.linspace(now, np.asarray(q, dtype=float), n)
    rows = np.column_stack((arm_rows, np.full(n, grip, dtype=float)))
    return r.submit("joint_position", rows, dt=DT, video="frames", cameras=cameras)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    o = r.get_obs()
    q_now = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"][:7], dtype=float)
